prompt:
LAYOUT IS THE MOST IMPORTANT REQUIREMENT: FOUR frames in ONE straight horizontal row, evenly spaced, WIDE EMPTY GAPS between them, all four the SAME SIZE, feet planted on the SAME invisible ground line, on a plain background. This is a sprite sheet, not an illustration.

Recreate the attached character EXACTLY — same design, same proportions, same colours, same pixel-art rendering — four times, as a subtle BREATHING TENSION loop of his battojutsu coil. The pose stays the same in all four; only small living details move, a few pixels at most:
FRAME 1: exactly the attached pose.
FRAME 2: he sinks a hair lower, shoulders tightening, grip firming on the saya.
FRAME 3: the lowest point of the breath — ponytail and the haori hem sway slightly forward.
FRAME 4: easing back up toward frame 1, hem settling back.

He never stands, never draws the blade, never moves his feet. The differences between frames are SMALL — chest rise, hem sway, tension. A viewer flipping through them should see one held breath, not four poses.
